findings.evidenceJa: 確実に躱し、かつ慎二に飛びかかる
findings.governingReading: Shirou doubts whether his body can both evade with certainty and pounce on Shinji in the same motion.
findings.explanation: Certain evasion plus a simultaneous leap at Shinji becomes generic dodging and attacking.

findings.highlight: third blade flying at my unprotected forehead
findings.evidenceJa: 無防備なこめかみに伸び上がる三刃
findings.governingReading: The third blade rises toward his exposed temple as he evades by running forward.
findings.explanation: A blade aimed at Shirou’s temple becomes one aimed at his forehead.

findings.highlight: I don't even need to see where these are going
findings.evidenceJa: 今度は様子を見るまでもない
findings.governingReading: After reading speed and range from the first volley, Shirou no longer needs a cautious observation pass.
findings.explanation: No longer needing to observe or test the second volley becomes not needing to see its path.
